hypotheses.C0_context_beats_isolated_token_code: Across competent labels, contextual rank-64 coalitions exceed separately fitted isolated-token rank-64 coalitions by at least 0.03 median AUROC in at least one layer.
hypotheses.C1_context_matters_for_many_features: At least one third of competent labels gain at least 0.05 AUROC from contextual rather than isolated-token rank-64 products in the better layer.
hypotheses.C2_layer1_adds_more_context_than_layer0: The contextual-minus-isolated rank-64 gain is at least 0.02 larger in layer 1 than layer 0.
hypotheses.C3_contextual_result_is_not_unigram_memo: Contextual rank-64 coalitions exceed the current-token unigram baseline by at least 0.03 median AUROC.
hypotheses.C4_same_examples_and_labels: Contextual, isolated-token, and unigram predictors use identical held-out sites and the feature set frozen in the source census.
